newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-VALENCIA INSIST ON ROMARIO'S RETURN TO SPAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VALENCIA INSIST ON ROMARIO'S RETURN TO SPAIN.

text.p: Valencia said on Tuesday that striker Romario must return from Brazil and play for them next season despite his reluctance to do so.
The Spanish club said it had lodged documents with the Spanish football federation which state that after July 22 Romario cannot play for any other club.
Spanish newspapers quoted Romario as saying that he wanted to stay in Brazil to be near his children.
"If I go to Spain I'm going to be a long way from my sons," the player said.
"Then I think that's not the best thing to do and it will be very difficult for me to be so far away from them."

Romario was signed by Valencia at the beginning of last season but was loaned back to his former club Flamengo. He has since recovered his lost form and was one of the Brazilian heroes of their recent Copa America triumph.
